title: Martin Heidegger
idiom: German Expressionist woodcut (Die Brücke / Kirchner) — stark gouged black line, no CGI
hero_prompt: A stark German Expressionist woodcut in the manner of Die Brücke: a dense black-forest of jagged, gouged vertical strokes, and punched through its center a narrow CLEARING of pale light where the trees thin — the opening is the brightest region, luminous and genuine. At the forest's edge a small rough-hewn wooden hut; in the near ground a single crude plank bridge crosses a stream, gathering the two banks toward the light. But a long hard shadow falls diagonally across the foreground, darkening the path to the clearing. High-contrast carved black lines on pale ground, no color, printmaking texture. No letters, numerals, words, labels, inscriptions — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast woodcut emblem, black on pale: a single ragged CLEARING of white light punched through a dense mass of gouged black forest strokes — an opening in darkness. Heavy carved blacks, no fine linework, survives at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels, inscriptions — purely pictorial.
